prompts: Create a new landscape 16:9 production background for a Vietnamese animated history film about the Hanging Gardens of Babylon. Use the attached Angkor Wat image ONLY as the drawing-style, palette, outline and shading reference, not its subject or architecture. Match its sophisticated comic animation look: expressive crisp dark ink outlines, three-value cel shading, richly crafted but readable details, warm ochre masonry, deep leafy greens and muted teal water, painterly-comic sky. NOT photorealistic, not 3D, not simplistic vector icons. Historical subject is an explicitly imaginative Mesopotamian garden reconstruction, NOT a verified archaeological reconstruction. Mesopotamian brick and stone, broad rectangular terraces, recessed brick pilasters and vaulted galleries; absolutely NO Angkor lotus towers, Khmer ornament, Thai pagodas, Roman columns, modern objects, floating buildings or magical levitation. No narrator, people, labels, letters, title, arrows, diagrams text, watermarks or border. Full bleed single finished artwork. Keep bottom 12% composition quiet for later subtitles. SHOT 1 / ESTABLISHING VIEW: A spectacular but grounded terraced royal garden beside a broad slow river in ancient Mesopotamia, low three-quarter viewpoint from the opposite bank. Three massive, progressively smaller rectangular terrace levels of honey-colored brick vaults, densely planted with date palms, vines, fig trees and leafy shrubs visibly rooted in the rooftop soil. The three levels have staggered arches and visible structural supports, with a modest flat-roof pavilion at the summit. The building occupies the middle 65% of the frame, river in bottom quarter, pale hazy low-rise mudbrick city and dry hills behind. Rich layered foreground reeds at a corner but no overhanging foreground tree. Morning golden light, crisp highlights, cool shadows. A tiny controlled irrigation runnel, not giant fantasy waterfalls. Compose an inviting visual reveal of a green artificial hill in an arid environment. Make the structure architecturally coherent, beautifully drawn and appealing as an animated-film establishing frame.

SHOT 2 / TERRACE CLOSEUP: Inside the same imagined three-tier Mesopotamian garden, camera looking diagonally along a wide planted upper terrace. In left foreground a tree grows from a substantial raised soil bed behind a thick masonry retaining wall; vines drape over its parapet. Midground brick arches below the planting deck clearly show that roots and earth are supported by architecture. A narrow shallow irrigation channel with small blue water glints runs along the terrace edge from lower right toward upper left. Other planted terraces rise in background to a modest flat-roof pavilion, framed by date palms and fig trees. A clear three-quarter perspective and balanced composition, with beautifully observed vegetation and masonry, coherent light from upper left. Show WHY 'hanging' means elevated planting, no floating vegetation or suspended flower pots. Richly finished ink and cel-color background, not an explanatory diagram.

SHOT 3 / CONCEPTUAL CUTAWAY: A beautiful, readable architectural section illustration of a hypothetical three-level Mesopotamian terraced garden in the same richly drawn comic background style. Side view with slight three-quarter depth. A clean cut face reveals thick masonry vaults supporting dark earth beds with trees and their roots above. Three broad stacked terraces climb from lower right to upper left, each with a visibly shallow irrigation channel near the planted surface. A simple vertical service shaft on the far left links a lower water reservoir near bottom left to a small upper cistern near upper left. Leave its mechanical contents blank/undefined: do NOT invent a waterwheel, screw pump, motor or bucket chain. No pipes passing through roots, no impossible water flow. ARCHAEOLOGY SHOT: An evocative illustrated archaeological excavation in southern Mesopotamia. A maze of very low broken mudbrick foundations, small excavated rooms, eroded brick walls and dusty paths in a wide flat arid landscape under pale blue sky. View from slightly above at a diagonal, with an unobtrusive excavation string grid and a small hand brush beside broken bricks in the lower left foreground. Beautiful observed brick edges and earth strata, honest and restrained. Absolutely no recognizable standing palace or reconstructed hanging garden in the ruins: the point is the absence of a conclusively identified garden, not to depict proof of one. A quiet contemplative scene, same sophisticated comic outline and shading as style reference, not a photo.
